articulation.alt: wear: /w/ → /ɛ/ → /r/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /w/: Round the lips; raise the back of the tongue.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
